body:
Follow-up to the 17.7 pre-release console records #21782 and #21784, on the maintainer's order to run every remaining necessary item: the four items the checklist marks `blocked` by fixture (the fixture was built outside the subject tree and supplied at runtime), and the two CLI scaffold items that the earlier run could only judge against the published 17.6.0 scaffolder. Text only; the durable truth stays in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Subject A** (approvals, identity, records items): `objectstack-ai/objectstack` `316be321e`, the same subject as #21782 / #21784, console pin `2e818d0b51ec` (stamp checked).
- **Subject B** (CLI scaffold items): current `origin/main` `53021e3a63` in a scratch worktree (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`, exit 0), console pin `9dfaca65` built with `scripts/build-console.sh`. All 69 public workspace packages were packed and published **only** to a localhost registry with no upstream for `@objectstack/*` / `create-objectstack`; the scaffold's lockfile integrity matches the local tarballs, proving the candidate was what got installed. Nothing was published anywhere else.
- **Boots:** `examples/app-showcase` (or a scratch copy of it with `node_modules` symlinked), one file DB per item, dedicated port ranges. Fixtures: an in-process clock shim loaded via `NODE_OPTIONS --require` (wall-clock offset only; no product logic changed), a local authorization-code + PKCE OIDC provider registered through the auth service's public config patch, and the objectui import-console spec run from a scratch copy with its live gate on. Personas minted by invite + sign-up, identity proved with `GET /auth/get-session` before each cell.
- **Execution:** runner lanes FE18, FE20, FE21 and independent verifier VF7 (RUNNER rule 7), Claude Code session `session_018zT8d8NpiQ1ExhuNd5TxY6`, 2026-10-05.

## Items

| item | rev | verdict | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| approvals.quorum-m-of-n | 3 | PASS | 2-of-2 and 2-of-3 on fresh requests: opens 0 of 2, one approve leaves it pending with the remaining holders, the second distinct approve finalizes; one reject vetoes and later decisions get 409; the third approver's task closes at quorum (inbox 2→1); drawer tally equals the API at every stage; repeat and non-holder decisions refused 403 |
| cli.scaffold-first-run | 2 | PASS | 17.7 candidate (subject B): scaffold `-t blank` → validate 0 → build 0 → `os start --artifact` health 200 / ready; no protocol skew; skills add installs exactly the 10 public skills, 0 internal |
| cli.scaffold-console-first-paint | 2 | PASS | 17.7 candidate: `os dev --ui` and bare `objectstack dev` serve the same console first paint (sign-in card with the dev-admin banner, 0 page errors); seeded admin signs in; Studio record create 201 and reads back |
| approvals.sla-escalation | 2 | **FAIL** | A4 product: the submitter's SLA notification arrives with an empty body; A5 product: the build accepts unknown escalation keys. A1–A3, N1–N3 pass: `sla_due_at` = created + timeoutHours; exactly one escalate row per request across sweeps and a restart; reassign / notify / auto_approve / auto_reject each take effect |
| identity-auth.linked-accounts-social | 2 | **FAIL** | A4 / N4 product: the "Link Social Account" action is dead on every boot (and offers a fixed provider list on a provider-less boot). A1–A3, A5 pass with a local OIDC provider: link via the authenticated link door creates exactly the caller's row; the view shows only the caller's links; unlink by row id removes exactly that link; the identity table is read-only over the data API (405) |
| records-forms.import-job-undo-cancel | 2 | PASS | objectui `import-console-undo.spec.ts` passes twice with its live gate on (skips without it, as the control); API: undo removes exactly the imported rows and restores upserted ones; cancel mid-job leaves a gap-free partial that stays undoable; the job list distinguishes undoable and reverted |

**Totals: 4 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 2 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** Both fails carry product defects; each was re-derived by verifier VF7.

## Fails — reproduction rules and dispositions

**approvals.sla-escalation A4** — product defect, medium, predates 17.6.0. Register an approval flow (admin `POST /api/v1/automation`) whose approval node has `escalation {enabled:true, timeoutHours:1, action:'notify', notifySubmitter:true}`; a member creates the trigger record; advance past `sla_due_at` and let a sweep run; as the submitter read `GET /api/v1/notifications`. Expected: a notification naming the action. Actual: title only, `body ""`. Mechanism: every approval `notify()` site in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` (helper ~1373-1410) puts its text in `payload.message`, while `packages/services/service-messaging/src/dispatcher.ts:341` (and the emit-time notification) read only `payload.body` — so every approval notification, including comments and request-info text, lands without a body. `{card-notify}`

**approvals.sla-escalation A5** — product defect (build-time gap), low-medium, predates 17.6.0. A flow whose approval node carries `escalation.bogusKey` (or the `timeout` alias) passes `objectstack validate` and `objectstack compile` (the key is copied into `dist/objectstack.json`); only registration and execution refuse it, and a cold boot drops the flow with a WARN. Mechanism: `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-node-config-refusals.ts:94-111` covers built-in node types only. Related, found in the same run: `escalation.timeoutHours: 0.5` is accepted at registration (key names only, `service-automation/src/engine.ts` ~10425-10480) and then every run fails at execute (`approval.zod.ts:666` `min(1)`), so the trigger record is created with no approval gate and only a log line. `{card-escalation-build}` `{card-escalation-values}`

**identity-auth.linked-accounts-social A4 / N4** — product defect, medium, predates 17.6.0. On a stock boot (`/auth/config` `socialProviders []`), Account → Linked Accounts → "Link Social Account" offers a fixed list of 7 providers; confirming navigates to `GET /api/v1/auth/sign-in/social?provider=…`, which answers 404 (the route is POST-only). On a configured boot the same action still cannot link: it targets the sign-in door, not the authenticated link door. Mechanism: `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-account.object.ts:58-84` declares `link_social` as a `type:'url'` action with a static option list and no visibility gate. `{card-link-social}`

## Authorization class (withheld)

- **identity-auth.linked-accounts-social, outside the item's clauses** — authorization class. Detail withheld pending maintainer (RUNNER rule 2). Verifier: CONFIRMED. `{card-linking}`

## Candidates and findings outside the clauses

- objectui import wizard: after Cancel, the result says "0 imported" while the server committed the processed rows (verified from source). `{card-import-cancel}`
- Showcase fixture: the per-group expense sign-off flow has no amount ceiling and opens first on any ≥5000 report, so the committee-quorum demo cannot be reached through the product UI (the quorum run fails `DUPLICATE_REQUEST`). Not verified independently; not extracted.
- Approval `pending_approvers` is not de-duplicated when one person holds several routed positions, so the drawer's "N eligible approvers" over-counts until the first vote (tally correct). Cosmetic; not extracted.

## Checklist accuracy and fixture notes (for the checklist owner)

1. **Lift `blocked` on all four fixture-blocked items run here**; the fixture recipes (runtime position grants plus disabling the competing sign-off flow for quorum; the clock shim for SLA; the local OIDC provider and the authenticated link door for linked accounts; the live-gated console spec with a `/_console` path for import) are held in the runner session and go into the re-point card.
2. quorum N1 ignores the documented admin override (#3424): an override decision finalizes by design — the clause should require a non-privileged repeat actor. A3's "reject edge" is not observable in run steps (end nodes log no step).
3. sla-escalation: name the 5-minute sweep interval plus the boot catch-up sweep; no writable package is needed.
4. linked-accounts-social: nav label is "Linked Accounts" in the Account app; step 2 must use the authenticated link door.
5. import-job-undo-cancel: `revertedAt` is absent (not null) until reverted; progress/results/cancel/undo live under `/data/import/jobs`.
6. Both CLI items: the trailing `npm install` fails on a pnpm-installed scaffold (17.6.0 and 17.7 alike) — drop the step or use `pnpm install`; add a pre-release variant that installs the candidate from a local registry, since the published path can only measure what is released; "installed set" should say "unique skill names"; console-first-paint A4's action/nav half has nothing to act on in a blank scaffold.
